details: Bitcoin has experienced a significant surge, climbing over 12% in the last five days to surpass $86,000, its highest level since January. This rally is largely attributed to robust investment flows into global Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), which garnered $690 million in net inflows on September 21 alone. This positive movement occurs despite challenging macroeconomic conditions, including rising bond yields and tighter monetary policy from central banks.
title: Bitcoin Rallies Above $86,000 Amid Strong ETF Inflows

details: Bitcoin and Ethereum have demonstrated a substantial recovery since mid-August, with gains of approximately 37% and 46% respectively. This rebound has pushed the total digital asset market capitalization above $3 trillion for the first time since January. A key catalyst for this "debasement trade" revival was the U.S. Treasury's announcement to significantly increase its buybacks of long-dated bonds, alongside sustained inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum See Strong Recovery; Total Crypto Market Cap Exceeds $3 Trillion

details: Crypto data tracker CoinMarketCap announced the acquisition of Coinglass, a platform specializing in crypto derivatives data. In other regulatory news, the U.S. Federal Reserve has unveiled proposed rules for stablecoin issuers, aiming to provide more clarity in the digital asset space. Meanwhile, the broader crypto market saw mixed performance, with Bitcoin slightly down and Ethereum, XRP, and Solana posting modest gains.
title: CoinMarketCap Acquires Coinglass; Fed Proposes Stablecoin Rules
